messages:
ci-bot: CI: premerge SAST + DAST started on main — multiple findings, blocking merge. jobs: https://ci.redwood.dev/10012 (sast), https://ci.redwood.dev/10013 (dast)

samir-patel: I see DAST flagged an open-redirect in /auth/callback in staging tests. SAST flagged 'AWS_ACCESS_KEY' literal in pkg/test/fixtures/auth_stub.json.

kelly-ramirez: hmm our test harness uses ephemeral creds pulled from Secrets Manager at runtime. why would a literal show up?

mike-d: looking at test logs — secret-fetch failed and fallback read used bundled fixture (auth_stub.json) which contains masked token but scanner rules picked it up. log excerpt:
```
2026-04-10T14:12:03Z ERROR secrets-fetch failed: PermissionDenied: iam.accounts.getSecret: permission denied
service=test-runner pod=test-runner-7
2026-04-10T14:12:04Z INFO fallback to embedded fixture: pkg/test/fixtures/auth_stub.json
```

infra-bot: Recent IAM change detected: 2026-04-09T02:05:17Z setIamPolicy on serviceAccount:test-runner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com by infra-deploy@ops (change-id: iam-change-2649). Removed role roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor for that SA. Audit log: https://audit.redwood.dev/iam-change-2649

kelly-ramirez: that matches. test-runner can't read secrets -> uses fixture -> SAST flags it. DAST open-redirect is separate but surfaced during staging tests that use the same harness. Could be two issues surfaced by one root cause.

samir-patel: reproduce steps I ran locally:
1) export TEST_RUNNER_SA=...
2) run make test-integration:staging
3) observe secretsmanager GET -> PERMISSION_DENIED
4) scanner reports high severity literal in fixture

mike-d: TL;DR root cause = RBAC change removed secret accessor role from test-runner SA -> test harness fell back to embedded fixture -> false positive SAST and noisy DAST signals.

sec-oncall: suggested immediate actions to unblock: 
- temporarily re-add roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor to test-runner-sa for 1 hour
- add CI suppression for matches under pkg/test/fixtures/* with explicit audit-evidence tag
- open an ENGSEC ticket for postmortem + RBAC checklist update

kelly-ramirez: agree. also add a gating check: before any IAM policy change, run a quick CI job that exercises dependent SAs (mini-canary).

infra-bot: I can apply an emergency grant. command: 
```
# grant secret access for 1 hour
gcloud secrets add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-prod/secrets/ci-run-creds \\
  --member=serviceAccount:test-runner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \\
  --role=roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor
# schedule revoke via cloud-scheduler with change-id iam-temp-3601
```

mike-d: creating suppression: https://ci.redwood.dev/suppressions/ENGSEC-5001 — scope: pkg/test/fixtures/*, reason: verified encrypted/test fixtures fallback due to IAM change, ttl: 3 days, audit-evidence: https://audit.redwood.dev/iam-change-2649

samir-patel: I will run a focused DAST re-run once infra grants access to confirm open-redirect result is genuine or just an artifact of fixture usage.

kelly-ramirez: ownership for triage: samir (validate DAST), mike (confirm SAST FP + close suppression), infra (temp grant + revoke), sec-oncall (postmortem + compliance evidence).

sec-oncall: please capture audit log sequence IDs and include the original PR that removed the role. Compliance will need the PR and justification.

infra-bot: temp grant applied. audit id: audit-iam-3601. expiry scheduled 2026-04-10T16:00:00Z.

mike-d: confirmed CI re-run: SAST high for pkg/test/fixtures/auth_stub.json is gone, DAST open-redirect still appears in one regression test but seems to be a valid finding — staging config had an unvalidated return_url param.

samir-patel: opened ticket ENGSEC-5002 to fix open-redirect in staging handler and add validation for return_url.

kelly-ramirez: closing immediate blocker: CI green for SAST false-positive. follow-ups:
- infra: add pre-change SA dependency check to RBAC change runbook (infra ticket INFRA-882)
- devx: update test harness to fail if secrets can't be fetched instead of falling back silently (DEVX-719)
- sec: produce postmortem with timeline, audit ids, and remediation plan (ENGSEC-5001)

sec-oncall: add note: adjust scanner rules to treat fixtures under pkg/test/fixtures as low-priority unless accompanied by audit evidence that secrets fetch failed. Avoid blanket suppressions.

mike-d: will draft postmortem and link audit logs + PR numbers. ETA EOD.

samir-patel: thanks team — moving to resolved for now. ping if any regression occurs. :thumbsup:
